lanes.title: concealment and preparation actions, ambushes and the equal-sides rule (D-082 DA6, DA7, DA8)
lanes.brief: SCOPE LIMITS: work only in prototypes/m7-sprint1 (M7Proto.slnx; M7Econ.slnx only if economy code is touched) and docs/m7-plan; no change to Sim.Core, Sim.Data, Sim.Cli, Sim.Ui or their tests, no unit data or cap change, no permanent project, no CI change (D-079 §6, Q5 open). Every design document is marked PROPOSAL; every reading is labelled READING with both alternatives; no Director decision is invented or reopened. Read docs/d082-morale-caps-ties-director-answers-2026-11-10.md in full first (the Director's message of 2026-11-10, DA1-DA9, its readings DA1-R..DA8-R, §3 supersessions, §5 not decided). (1) DESIGN PROPOSAL docs/m7-plan/concealment-actions-proposal.md: units spend action points (DA8-R: T3's Action Capacity, DR22, C23; reports/G-action-windows-t3.md; Proto.M7/War/ActionWindows.cs) on hide, camouflage and entrench, plus any further action as a labelled proposal ('etc.' is delegated). For each: its cost in action points, preconditions (terrain, vegetation, stationary, not in contact), duration and what ends it (moving, firing, being spotted, a new window), and its MECHANISM (Law 2, never a free-floating buff): hiding and camouflage act through detection (T2's WarFog, Proto.M7/War/WarFog.cs, and the knowledge seam's detection rules; reports/G-war-pulse-t2.md), for example by shortening the distance at which an observer detects the unit; entrenching builds field works over time at a dt-correct rate that become cover or obstacle cells on lane TR's battle grid (reports/H-TR.md) and are lost when the unit leaves. Say at which level each action exists (the war-pulse and action-window layer, the tactical battle, or both) and why. Define who the DEFENDER of a battle is: the prototype's BattleSetup has no battle-level attacker or defender today (lane S's siege rows have one; lane P's terrain scenarios give one side a Defend posture). State it as a READING with both alternatives (for example (a) the side the war-pulse engagement names as attacked: the side whose position was entered, or that held a Defend posture when contact began; (b) the side that did not initiate contact), carry it on the battle setup as an explicit field, and say what every existing scenario sets it to. Define an AMBUSH precisely and deterministically (for example: a battle whose attacking formations were undetected by the defender at the instant contact is made) and how it is flagged on the battle setup. Interplay with the deployment thirds (DR31) and lane D's sandbox (offer the actions there too). (2) EQUAL SIDES (DA6, DA7): in lane P's AutoResolver (Proto.M7/Tactical/AutoResolver.cs; reports/H-P.md), when the result separates neither side the defender wins; in an ambush launched from concealment the ambusher wins (DA7-R (a)). Define 'equal' exactly and deterministically (DA6-R; exact equality of the deciding quantity in integer or exact arithmetic, or a stated band, with the reason), with a tie-dense test at and around the boundary. Measure what the rule changes on lane P's parity battery (and, for information only, the battery with the rule and lane MOR's in-battle rule at c = 200 together, as H-MOR proposes for the next re-measurement; leave MOR's default at 0) and say whether any acceptance number moves (lane P's acceptance stays OPEN, Q4; do not accept or tune parity). The extension to the TacticalResolver's UNRATIFIED Standoff end (lane TR, P-TR1) is a PROPOSAL only: analyse it, implement it at most behind an option that is OFF by default, and measure what it would change. (3) PROTOTYPE: implement hide, camouflage, entrench (and any extra action the proposal adopts) as action kinds with refusal codes, concealment and works state, detection interplay, the ambush flag and the equal-sides rule. Semantic tests per mechanism; turn-exact order-delivery pins for every action (when it takes effect relative to when it was ordered; replay equality alone is not enough); tie-dense ordering tests; POPULATED-table round-trip tests for any new serialized row; exact conservation where stocks move (field works use materials or labour only through the existing ledger paths, if at all); bounded mutants each killed by a semantic test. Lane MOR (H-MOR) is on the branch: make the resolvers' reported winner (lane MOR's BattleWinner.Reported) carry the DA6 and DA7 winners, and add a test that a battle won by the defender on equal sides, and one won from an ambush, raise the winner's morale through the DA1 rule. (4) Lane report prototypes/m7-sprint1/reports/H-AP.md (what exists, design, readings, Director decisions only where genuinely undecided, MEASURED vs INFERRED, tests, mutants, what ran, NOT RUN, deferred). Builds and tests: M7Proto.slnx Debug and Release, the determinism scan, the doc links.
